summary: CareTrust REIT's UK subsidiary completed the acquisition of the entire issued share capital of LNT care home property companies holding 23 completed care homes on October 1, 2026, with a 24th pending regulatory approval, under a September 30, 2026 Share Purchase Deed. Purchase price is £24 million per property, approximately £576 million ($764 million) aggregate for the 24 Completed Properties, plus put/call options for up to 21 In-Development Properties at roughly £504 million ($669 million) through December 31, 2027. Properties are triple-net leased to Crystal Care Holdco with LNT guarantees. Watch opco acquisition options, regulatory approvals, and lease-up execution risk.
